sections.Description:
With a sick sewer lair and tough friends like April O’Neil and Casey Jones, the Turtles are about to face evils more dangerous and pizza more delicious than anything they could have ever imagined.

In this pinball adventure players will go to battle as the Turtles fight villains like Shredder, the Krang and loads of super-powerful mutants, to become the heroes they were destined to be, and have loads of fun along the way!
sections.Gameplay Features:
- Load the Van: Featuring an interactive custom sculpted Turtles Van, equipped to lock up to 4 balls inside with a mechanical opening/closing side door, ready to unleash multiball havoc upon players.
- Control the Glider: The TMNT Glider, a custom-sculpted, player-controlled diverter assembly stationed above both ramps, giving players the ability to control and transport the ball to the flipper of their choice.
- Pizza Mayhem: Look out for the high speed magnetic spinning pizza disc capable of holding and throwing 3 balls during pizza multiball mayhem.
sections.Editions:
Pro:
- Start the game with player selectable Turtle for special game features and powers.
- Exclusive distinctive hand-drawn artwork by Zombie Yeti.
- Original 1987 theme music complements the action with custom video scenes and events created exclusively for this pinball experience.

Premium:
- Premium model features Mouser Invasion themed full color translite and unique side cabinet hand-drawn artwork by Zombie Yeti.
- Start the game with player selectable Turtle for special game features and powers.
- Powder-coated steel bottom arch with black wrinkle finish side armor, hinges and front lockdown bar.

Limited Edition:
- Designer Autographed collectible featuring signature of game designer John Borg.
- Limited Edition exclusive inside art blades hand-drawn artwork by Zombie Yeti.
- Custom high gloss Sour Apple Green powder-coated armor and legs.
